messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the major long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023. (All dates are in the local time zone for each holiday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | **Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Family Day (Ontario)** | Monday, Feb 20 | **Fri Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | **Fri May 20 – Mon May 22** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | **Fri Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | **Fri Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday, Nov 11 | **Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | **Fri Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** (3‑day weekend) |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, Dec 26 | **Tue Dec 26 – Thu Dec 28** (optional 4‑day if you take Wed off) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Feb 17, 2023).  
> • If you’re planning trips for a specific province, let me know and I can add those provincial long weekends too!
message.reasoning:
The user wants the list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. So we cannot use the tool. We should respond with the data. We can provide the list manually. Let's recall Canadian public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. Long weekends typically include holidays that fall on Friday or Monday, creating a 3-day weekend. Also sometimes holidays that fall on Thursday or Tuesday can create a 4-day weekend if people take an extra day.

We need to list all long weekends in Canada in 2023. That includes federal holidays and provincial ones? The user didn't specify provinces. Probably they want national holidays. But Canada has many provincial holidays. For simplicity, we can list the federal holidays that create long weekends. Federal holidays in Canada: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (varies by province), Good Friday (varies by province), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas Day (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). Some of these create long weekends.

Let's list:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1, 2023 was Sunday. So long weekend: Dec 31, 2022 (Saturday) to Jan 2, 2023 (Monday). That's a 3-day weekend.

- Family Day: In Ontario, it's third Monday in February. In 2023, Family Day in Ontario was Feb 20. So long weekend: Feb 18-20 (Friday to Monday). Also in other provinces like Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc. But we can mention Ontario.

- Good Friday: In 2023, Good Friday was April 7. So long weekend: Apr 7-9 (Friday to Sunday). Actually Good Friday is a holiday, so long weekend: Apr 7-9.

- Victoria Day: May 22, 2023 was Monday. So long weekend: May 20-22 (Friday to Monday).

- Canada Day: July 1, 2023 was Saturday. So long weekend: Jul 1-3 (Saturday to Monday). Actually Canada Day is a holiday, so long weekend: Jul 1-3.

- Labour Day: Sep 4, 2023 was Monday. So long weekend: Sep 2-4 (Friday to Monday).

- Thanksgiving: Oct 9, 2023 was Monday. So long weekend: Oct 7-9 (Friday to Monday).

- Remembrance Day: Nov 11, 2023 was Saturday. So long weekend: Nov 11-13 (Saturday to Monday).

- Christmas Day: Dec 25, 2023 was Monday. So long weekend: Dec 23-25 (Friday to Monday).

- Boxing Day: Dec 26, 2023 was Tuesday. So long weekend: Dec 26-28 (Tuesday to Thursday). Actually Boxing Day is a holiday, but it's not a long weekend unless you take an extra day. But it's a holiday on Tuesday, so you could take Wednesday off to get a 4-day weekend. But we can mention that.

Also some provinces have holidays like St. Patrick's Day in Newfoundland and Labrador (Feb 17), etc. But we can focus on federal.

Thus we can provide a list of long weekends in Canada in 2023:

- New Year's Day: Dec 31, 2022 – Jan 2, 2023
- Family Day (Ontario): Feb 18–20, 2023
- Good Friday: Apr 7–9, 2023
- Victoria Day: May 20–22, 2023
- Canada Day: Jul 1–3, 2023
- Labour Day: Sep 2–4, 2023
- Thanksgiving: Oct 7–9, 2023
- Remembrance Day: Nov 11–13, 2023
- Christmas Day: Dec 23–25, 2023
- Boxing Day: Dec 26–28, 2023 (optional)

We can also mention that some provinces have additional long weekends like St. Patrick's Day in NL (Feb 17, 2023 was Friday, so long weekend: Feb 15-17). But we can keep it simple.

We should respond with the list. No tool usage needed.
